rigidity_45_unconditional_155free.description: Unconditional Heavy-Mover Subspace Rigidity of best45_seed105_ckpt.json on the 155-ring free subspace (only 22 O>0 collateral-bearing rings pinned, 0 home rings pinned; 30-branch case split on (c2, c3, c5)).

global_lb40_pillars7_c17_branched_170fre.description: Global Lower Bound d(1500) >= 40 on the 170-ring free subspace with only the 7 immovable pillars {2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 31} at home and an exhaustive 17-branch case split over c_17 in {0, 1, ..., 16} (covering both the c_17=0 47-basin and the c_17=1 45-basin).
